def run(args, data):
    directory = args.root/RUN_NAME
    (directory/'launches').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ')
    launch = dict(id=stamp, arm='B', status='started', started_unix=time.time(), host=socket.gethostname(),
        pid=os.getpid(), gpu_uuid=GPU_UUID, formal=True, tmux_session='r69_train',
        tmux_pane=os.environ.get('R69_TMUX_PANE_ID', ''), tmux_pane_pid=os.environ.get('R69_TMUX_PANE_PID', ''),
        tmux_server_host=os.environ.get('R69_TMUX_SERVER_HOST', ''),
        slurm_step=os.environ.get('SLURM_JOB_ID', '')+'.'+os.environ.get('SLURM_STEP_ID', ''))
    started, status = time.monotonic(), 'failed'
    atomic_json(directory/'launches'/(stamp+'.json'), launch)
    with (directory/'train.log').open('a') as stream, redirect_stdout(Tee(sys.stdout, stream)), redirect_stderr(Tee(sys.stderr, stream)):
        try:
            train_arm(args, data, launch)
            status = 'complete'
        finally:
            launch.update(status=status, wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-started, finished_unix=time.time())
            atomic_json(directory/'launches'/(stamp+'.json'), launch)
            atomic_json(directory/'wall_time.json', [launch])
            atomic_json(args.root/'current_status.json', launch)
            if status == 'complete':
                result = json.loads((directory/'result.json').read_text())
                result['wall_seconds'] = launch['wall_seconds']
                atomic_json(directory/'result.json', result)


def publish_candidate(root):
    result = json.loads((root/RUN_NAME/'result.json').read_text())
    control = json.loads((root/'reused_control.json').read_text())['model']
    candidate = dict(path=str(root/RUN_NAME/'best.pt'), sha256=result['best_checkpoint_sha256'],
        selected_epoch_checkpoint=result['selected_epoch_checkpoint'], epoch=result['best']['epoch'],
        global_epoch=result['best']['global_epoch'], native_correct=result['best']['val']['native_correct'],
        native_total=18000, val=result['best']['val']['macro'], parameter_mode=PARAMETER_MODE,
        model_type='complete_task_specific_bank', all18_common_epoch=True)
    official = 'B' if candidate['native_correct'] > 8644 else 'A'
    atomic_json(root/'validation_candidates.json', dict(models={'A': control, 'B': candidate},
        proposed_official_arm=official, official_rule='B strictly>8644; tie/lower fixed A',
        new_arms=['B'], reused_arms=['A'], parent_freeze_pending=True, inference_rule=INFERENCE_RULE,
        test_authorized=False, later_test='parent freezes B bundle and official arm, then ONE original full18 TEST for new B; reuse existing A TEST unchanged'))


def cpu_check(args):
    from .r69_cpu_check import focused_check
    path = args.root/'cpu_check_invocations.jsonl'
    if path.exists():
        previous = [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines()]
        if any(item['status'] == 'passed' for item in previous):
            raise ValueError('The one focused R69 CPU check already passed; no repeat campaign')
        invocation = 1+sum(item['status'] == 'started' for item in previous)
    else:
        invocation = 1
    started = time.monotonic()
    receipt = dict(invocation=invocation, type='focused synthetic CPU check', started_utc=utc_now(),
                   pid=os.getpid(), status='started', gpu_used=False, source_hashes=source_hashes())
    append_jsonl(path, receipt)
    with (args.root/'cpu_check.log').open('a') as stream, redirect_stdout(Tee(sys.stdout, stream)), redirect_stderr(Tee(sys.stderr, stream)):
        try:
            result = dict(focused_check(), invocation=invocation, started_utc=receipt['started_utc'],
                          wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-started, source_hashes=receipt['source_hashes'])
            atomic_json(args.root/'cpu_check.json', result)
            append_jsonl(path, dict(receipt, status='passed', wall_seconds=result['wall_seconds']))
            print('[R69 focused CPU check] '+json.dumps(result), flush=True)
        except BaseException as error:
            append_jsonl(path, dict(receipt, status='failed', wall_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,
                                   error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error)))
            raise


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--stage', choices=('cpu-check', 'train'), default='train')
    parser.add_argument('--wandb', action=argparse.BooleanOptionalAction, default=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    args.root, args.reference, args.device, args.batch_size = ROOT, REFERENCE, 'cuda:0', 256
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    args.root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.stage == 'cpu-check':
        cpu_check(args)
        return
    if (os.environ.get('CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES') != GPU_UUID or os.environ.get('SLURM_JOB_ID') != '1465'
            or socket.gethostname().split('.')[0] != 'gpu03'):
        parser.error('R69 requires assigned existing Slurm1465/gpu03/index1 UUID launcher')
    check = json.loads((args.root/'cpu_check.json').read_text())
    if not check.get('passed') or check['source_hashes'] != source_hashes():
        parser.error('The one focused CPU check must pass on these exact launch sources')
    configure_torch()
    try:
        data = prepare(args)
        run(args, data)
        publish_candidate(args.root)
        atomic_json(args.root/'training_complete.json', dict(completed_utc=utc_now(), new_arms=['B'],
            reused_control='fixed R68A28', epochs=40, new_updates=UPDATES, new_presentations=PRESENTATIONS,
            successful_view_rows=VIEW_ROWS, inherited_stage1_updates_once=9600,
            inherited_stage1_presentations_once=7200000, parent_freeze_pending=True, test_authorized=False))
        print('[R69 training complete] one new B; parent freeze pending; no TEST/analysis executed', flush=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        atomic_json(args.root/'terminal_failure.json', dict(recorded_utc=utc_now(),
            error_type=type(error).__name__, error=str(error), pid=os.getpid(),
            slurm_step=os.environ.get('SLURM_JOB_ID', '')+'.'+os.environ.get('SLURM_STEP_ID', ''),
            automatic_restart=False, samples_skipped=False, duplicate_attempt_authorized=False))
        raise

import math

import torch

from .r68_gradient import GradientLayout as BranchLayout
from .r69_model import model_inputs
from .training_monitor import capture_rng, restore_rng


class GradientLayout:
    def __init__(self, model):
        self.branches = [BranchLayout(branch) for branch in model.branches]
        self.parameters = [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]
        self.receipt = dict(total_elements=sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters),
            branch_elements=[sum(p.numel() for p in branch.parameters) for branch in self.branches],
            reduction='each active branch FP32 task gradient divided by3 in disjoint coordinates',
            clip='one global active gradient clip at1', inactive='grad=None; no Adam state/decay advancement',
            projected=False, per_task_normalization=False)


class NonfiniteTask(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, task):
        super().__init__(f'Nonfinite R69 task gradient/output: {task}')
        self.task = task


def disjoint_pass(model, optimizer, scaler, batches, consistency_weight, layout, view_rows):
    gradients, values, norms = [], [], []
    scale = float(scaler.get_scale())
    for position, batch in enumerate(batches):
        branch_id = model.branch_index(batch['problem_id'])
        branch = layout.branches[branch_id]
        optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=batch['ind'].device.type, dtype=torch.float16,
                            enabled=scaler.is_enabled()):
            view_rows[0] += len(batch['ind'])
            first = model(model_inputs(batch))
            view_rows[0] += len(batch['ind'])
            second = model(model_inputs(batch))
        loss, parts = classification_objective(first, second, batch['ind'], consistency_weight)
        scaled_loss = scaler.scale(loss)
        item = {key: float(value.detach()) for key, value in dict(loss=loss, **parts).items()}
        finite_outputs = all(bool(torch.isfinite(out['logits'][out['solver_mask']]).all())
                             for out in (first, second))
        if not finite_outputs or not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in item.values()):
            raise NonfiniteTask(position)
        scaled_loss.backward()
        gradient = branch.unscaled_buffer(scale)
        norm = gradient.norm()
        if not bool(torch.isfinite(gradient).all()) or not bool(torch.isfinite(norm)):
            raise NonfiniteTask(position)
        active = [p.grad is not None for p in branch.parameters]
        gradients.append((branch_id, gradient, active))
        values.append(item)
        norms.append(float(norm))
    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
    for branch_id, gradient, active in gradients:
        layout.branches[branch_id].assign_active(gradient / 3., active)
    return values, norms, gradients


def update_triple(model, optimizer, scaler, batches, consistency_weight, layout, lr,
                  growth_successes=0):
    branch_ids = [model.branch_index(batch['problem_id']) for batch in batches]
    if len(batches) != 3 or len(set(branch_ids)) != 3:
        raise ValueError('R69 requires three distinct actual task batches at unchanged weights')
    rng = capture_rng()
    initial_scale, failures, view_rows = float(scaler.get_scale()), [], [0]
    for retry in range(20):
        restore_rng(rng)
        scale = float(scaler.get_scale())
        try:
            task_values, task_norms, gradients = disjoint_pass(
                model, optimizer, scaler, batches, consistency_weight, layout, view_rows)
            norm = float(torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(layout.parameters, 1., error_if_nonfinite=False))
            if not math.isfinite(norm):
                raise NonfiniteTask('combined_clip_norm')
        except NonfiniteTask as error:
            restore_rng(rng)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            failures.append(dict(attempt=retry+1, task=error.task, scale=scale,
                                 branch_ids=branch_ids, pass_name='first'))
            if not scaler.is_enabled():
                raise RuntimeError('Nonfinite R69 FP32 update; RNG/gradients restored; no advancement') from error
            scaler.update(new_scale=scale*scaler.get_backoff_factor())
            growth_successes = 0
            print(f'[R69 AMP retry] whole same triple; task={error.task}; '
                  f'scale={scaler.get_scale()}', flush=True)
            continue
        except BaseException:
            restore_rng(rng)
            optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)
            raise

        for group in optimizer.param_groups:
            group['lr'] = lr
        optimizer.step()
        if scaler.is_enabled():
            growth_successes += 1
            if growth_successes == scaler.get_growth_interval():
                scale *= scaler.get_growth_factor()
                growth_successes = 0
            scaler.update(new_scale=scale)

        return dict(**{key: sum(value[key] for value in task_values)/3 for key in task_values[0]},
            task_losses=task_values, full_task_grad_norms=task_norms,
            divided_task_grad_norms=[value/3 for value in task_norms],
            grad_norm=norm, clip_coefficient=min(1., 1./(norm+1e-6)),
            active_branch_ids=branch_ids,
            inactive_branch_ids=[index for index in range(18) if index not in branch_ids],
            active_gradient_elements=sum(sum(p.numel() for p, used in
                zip(layout.branches[index].parameters, active) if used)
                for index, _, active in gradients),
            unused_parameters_active_branches={str(index): [name for name, used in
                zip(layout.branches[index].names, active) if not used] for index, _, active in gradients},
            base_optimizer_steps=1, active_parameter_weight_decay_steps=1,
            inactive_parameter_steps=0, inactive_grad_none=True,
            successful_view_rows=2*rows, attempted_view_rows=view_rows[0],
            retries=retry, retry_attempts=failures, initial_scale=initial_scale,
            scale=float(scaler.get_scale()), scale_growth_successes=growth_successes,
            finite_loss=True, finite_gradient=True,
            reduction='FP32 task gradient /3 in each active disjoint branch',
            global_clip_calls=1, projected=False, per_task_normalization=False)

    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

def metric_rows(model, split, epoch, value):
    common = dict(model=model, split=split, epoch=epoch)
    rows = [dict(common, scope='ALL', kind='aggregate',
                 native_correct=value.get('native_correct'),
                 native_total=value.get('native_total', sum(p['n'] for p in value['per_problem'].values())),
                 **metrics(value['macro'], 'macro_'))]
    rows += [dict(common, scope=name, kind='family', **metrics(entry, 'macro_'))
             for name, entry in value['families'].items()]
    rows += [dict(common, scope=name, kind='task', native_correct=entry.get('native_correct'),
                  native_total=entry['n'], **metrics(entry))
             for name, entry in value['per_problem'].items()]
    return rows

    test_path = base/'test_results.json'

    for arm, name in {'A': 'A_mean_gradient_seed2', 'B': 'B_pcgrad_seed2'}.items():

def decision_metrics(scores, raw, mask=None):
    costs, winner = raw["costs"], raw["winner"]
    if mask is None:
        mask = np.ones_like(costs, dtype=bool)
    if not mask[np.arange(len(winner)), winner].all():
        raise ValueError("Native winners must belong to the valid pool")
    scores = np.where(mask, scores, -np.inf)
    rank = np.argsort(-scores, axis=1, kind="stable")
    pred = rank[:, 0]
    selected = costs[np.arange(len(pred)), pred]
    oracle = np.where(mask, costs, np.inf).min(1)
    common = mask.all(0)
    if not common.any():
        raise ValueError("SBS requires at least one solver available on every evaluation instance")
    sbs_idx = int(np.where(common, np.where(mask, costs, 0).mean(0), np.inf).argmin())
    sbs, vbs, mean_cost = float(costs.mean(0)[sbs_idx]), float(oracle.mean()), float(selected.mean())
    result = dict(n=len(pred), mean_cost=mean_cost, sbs=sbs, vbs=vbs, oracle_cost=vbs, sbs_cost=sbs,
                  sbs_name=raw["pool"][sbs_idx], top1_tie_aware=float((selected == oracle).mean()),
                  vs_sbs_pct=(mean_cost / sbs - 1) * 100, vs_oracle_pct=(mean_cost / vbs - 1) * 100,
                  actual_regret_pct=float(((selected - oracle) / oracle * 100).mean()),
                  vbs_gap_closed_pct=(sbs - mean_cost) / (sbs - vbs) * 100 if sbs != vbs else 0.0,
                  **{f"top{k}": float((rank[:, :k] == winner[:, None]).any(1).mean()) for k in (1, 2, 3)})
    result["pick_dist"] = (np.bincount(pred, minlength=costs.shape[1]) / len(pred)).tolist()
    result["arm_distribution"] = dict(zip(raw["pool"], result["pick_dist"]))
    return result, pred


def metrics_from_outputs(logits, prediction, raw, scale, decision_head, mask=None):
    mask = np.ones_like(logits, dtype=bool) if mask is None else mask
    if not mask.any(1).all() or not np.isfinite(logits[mask]).all() or not np.isfinite(prediction[mask]).all():
        raise RuntimeError("Nonfinite R39 evaluation output")
    logits = np.where(mask, logits, -np.inf)
    ce = float(F.cross_entropy(torch.from_numpy(logits), torch.from_numpy(raw["winner"])))
    target = make_targets(raw["costs"], scale, mask).numpy()
    values = np.where(mask, prediction, 0)
    counts = mask.sum(1)
    centered = values - (values.sum(1) / counts)[:, None]
    prediction = np.where(mask, centered, np.inf)
    squared = np.where(mask, (np.where(mask, prediction, 0).astype(np.float64) - target.astype(np.float64)) ** 2, 0)
    mse = float((squared.sum(1) / counts).mean())
    target_energy = float((np.square(target.astype(np.float64)).sum(1) / counts).mean())
    classification, class_pred = decision_metrics(logits, raw, mask)
    performance, perf_pred = decision_metrics(-prediction, raw, mask)
    main = dict(classification if decision_head == "classification" else performance)
    main.update(ce=ce, performance_mse=mse, performance_zero_mse=target_energy,
                performance_r2=1 - mse / target_energy if target_energy > 0 else 0.0,
                decision_head=decision_head, pool=raw["pool"], classification=classification, performance=performance)
    main["method_top1"] = dict(zip(raw["pool"], (np.bincount(raw["winner"], minlength=len(raw["pool"])) / len(raw["winner"])).tolist()))
    main["method_mean_cost"] = {name: float(raw["costs"][:, j].mean()) for j, name in enumerate(raw["pool"]) if mask[:, j].all()}
    for name, result in (("classification", classification), ("performance", performance)):
        for key in POLICY_METRICS:
            main[f"{key}_{name}"] = result[key]
    main["top1_exceeds_methods"] = [name for name, value in main["method_top1"].items() if main["top1"] > value]
    main["top1_not_exceeds_methods"] = [name for name, value in main["method_top1"].items() if main["top1"] <= value]
